731:t_027:36.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Every time $$シュロウガ$$ is revived, it has brought forth a being like you, over and over, to cure its own loneliness.」

731:t_027:38.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「So even you have fallen at last... It's only natural.」

731:t_027:39.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Your life was created for someone else's convenience... And what's more, it is a hollow, false life.」

731:t_027:41.en:
$$万丈$$
「I don't care about any truth like that! But it's a fact that you people toyed with $$アサキム$$'s fate and life for your own ends!」

731:t_027:42.en:
$$刹那$$
「You are... the very distortion of this planet!」

731:t_027:43.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Your words will never reach me.」

731:t_028:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Snap out of it! The $$御使い$$ you want revenge on is right in front of you!」

731:t_028:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It's useless. His self is already dead.」

731:t_028:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But his eternity continues. Within me...」

731:t_029:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You mean that bastard $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ swallowed it up!?」

731:t_029:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「With this, all eight $$スフィア$$s are gathered. The preparations for the Supreme God's rebirth will soon be complete.」

731:t_029:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「What's all this about a Supreme God...!?」

731:t_029:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It's just as I told you. My greatest purpose is to complete a new Supreme God, in order to overcome the great collapse of the universe.」

731:t_029:6.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Farewell, $c... With your power, you can no longer change the course of events.」

731:t_029:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Thank you. I will keep you in my memory, too, as warriors who labored to save the universe.」

731:t_030:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「All units, return at once! We'll regroup and go after him!」

731:t_030:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「I have a good idea where he's headed.」

731:t_030:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「If the ley lines of $$エス・テラン$$ are no different from those of our Earth, their stronghold can only be that place.」

731:t_030:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ラース・バビロン$$, then...!」

731:t_030:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's go! I won't let them keep using $$アサキム$$ any longer!」

731:t_030:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
「To settle things with him, too, I'll rescue him from the $$御使い$$s...!」

731:t_030:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We also have to put to rest the regret of $$サクリファイ$$, who finally came to understand us.」

731:t_030:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's go, $n. To the place of the decisive battle.」

731:t_030:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As expected, it has come to this...」

731:t_031:0.en:
$$葵$$
「We've cleared out the pests around us!」

731:t_031:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「All that's left is $$アサキム$$!」

731:t_031:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I've always been alone. I have no intention of relying on anyone's power.」

731:t_031:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Come at me. I hope you can heal my loneliness.」

731:t_100:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$アサキム$$! I'm going to take you down to avenge Uncle $$デンゼル$$ and Big Bro $$トビー$$!」

731:t_100:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I can understand that feeling of mourning someone who was lost.」

731:t_100:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't you say that, when you're the one who did it!」

731:t_100:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That's why I'll end it all here. And for that, I'll need your power too!」

731:t_101:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「You've given me plenty of trouble ever since the $$多元戦争$$, but it seems the time has come to repay that debt.」

731:t_101:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Yes... time for the showdown. By taking you as my offerings, I will gain a new power.」

731:t_101:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「That arrogance, treating everything as your own! $$ダイターン$$ and I will smash it!」

731:t_101:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I wish that anger of yours could burn my false eternity to ashes!」

731:t_102:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I won't show any mercy to someone who doesn't just covet other people's things but takes them by force!」

731:t_102:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I'll accept any bitter words, any contempt. That's the kind of being I am.」

731:t_102:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Stop using words nobody can understand! Either way, I'm not going to listen to anything you say anymore!」

731:t_102:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That's fine. Between me and you... only one side gets to move forward!」

731:t_103:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「My existence is the same as your puppet.」

731:t_103:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「No... that's not it. Unlike your puppet, I will not forgive whoever controls me.」

731:t_103:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'm saying we'll join forces to defeat the $$御使い$$s...! If you refuse that, we have no choice but to fight you too!」

731:t_104:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「We're the ones reaching out to you, so if you turn us down, don't complain if you get punched!」

731:t_104:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「As I said. Cooperation from the likes of you is meaningless.」

731:t_104:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Get ready, $$アサキム$$! You're going to be beaten by the likes of us!!」

731:t_104:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「If you can do that, then hope is born for me too!」

731:t_105:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I don't give a damn about your circumstances! If you're coming after us, we'll just meet you head-on!」

731:t_105:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That simple way of thinking... I don't dislike it.」

731:t_105:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Being liked by you doesn't make me happy at all! I'll end it here, $$アサキム$$!」

731:t_106:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「What do you want once you've overthrown the $$御使い$$s!?」

731:t_106:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I have no need to tell you that.」

731:t_106:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「Why do you reject us!? Is there really no way for us to join hands!?」

731:t_106:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「This is the only way I know how to live... That is my destiny, and my sin!」

731:t_107:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「I'll end your eternity with my drill!」

731:t_107:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It's eternal because it never ends. Don't you understand that?」

731:t_107:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Enough of your sophistry! I'll drill through even eternity!」

731:t_107:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「It's a showdown, $$アサキム$$! We'll surpass even you, the immortal!!」

731:t_108:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「While those close to you die one after another, you alone live on through time... Surely you can understand me a little?」

731:t_108:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's why we fight! To free you from eternity!」

731:t_108:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Then I'll look forward to it. Though I have no intention of holding back.」

731:t_108:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We don't need that! You're our enemy too!」

731:t_109:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Even after swallowing what you did to us, we're trying to meet you halfway...!」

731:t_109:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「What's needed to defeat them is overwhelming power. You and I merely joining forces won't get us there.」

731:t_109:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Don't give up before you've even tried!」

731:t_109:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Then I'll make you acknowledge our power! Even if I have to snap off those black wings you're so proud of!」
